import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")

# Create id column for train and test
train_df["id"] = (
    train_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + train_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)
test_df["id"] = (
    test_df["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test_df["token_id"].astype(str)
)

# Split training data for validation (80% train, 20% val) - KEEP THIS SEPARATE
train_sub, val_sub = train_test_split(train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)


# Feature Engineering
def get_features(df):
    features = pd.DataFrame()
    before_str = df["before"].fillna("").astype(str)

    features["len"] = before_str.str.len()
    features["is_digit"] = before_str.apply(lambda x: x.isdigit() if x else False)
    features["is_alpha"] = before_str.apply(lambda x: x.isalpha() if x else False)
    features["is_punct"] = before_str.apply(lambda x: x in ".,!?;:" if x else False)
    features["has_digit"] = before_str.apply(
        lambda x: any(c.isdigit() for c in x) if x else False
    )
    features["has_alpha"] = before_str.apply(
        lambda x: any(c.isalpha() for c in x) if x else False
    )
    features["digit_count"] = before_str.apply(
        lambda x: sum(c.isdigit() for c in x) if x else 0
    )
    features["alpha_count"] = before_str.apply(
        lambda x: sum(c.isalpha() for c in x) if x else 0
    )
    features["space_count"] = before_str.apply(lambda x: x.count(" ") if x else 0)
    features["first_char"] = before_str.apply(lambda x: ord(x[0]) if len(x) > 0 else 0)
    features["last_char"] = before_str.apply(lambda x: ord(x[-1]) if len(x) > 0 else 0)
    return features


# Prepare features - use train_sub for training, val_sub for validation
X_train = get_features(train_sub)
y_train = train_sub["class"]
X_val = get_features(val_sub)
y_val = val_sub["class"]
X_test = get_features(test_df)

# Encode class labels for LightGBM
le = LabelEncoder()
y_train_encoded = le.fit_transform(y_train)
y_val_encoded = le.transform(y_val)

# Train LightGBM on TRAIN SUBSET ONLY (not full train)
print("Training Class Predictor...")
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(le.classes_),
    "metric": "multi_error",
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "force_row_wise": True,
}
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train_encoded)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val_encoded, reference=train_data)

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Build Lookup Table from TRAIN SUBSET ONLY (not full train)
print("Building Lookup Table...")
train_unique = train_sub.drop_duplicates(subset=["class", "before"], keep="first")
train_unique["key"] = (
    train_unique["class"].astype(str)
    + "_"
    + train_unique["before"].fillna("").astype(str)
)
lookup_dict = dict(zip(train_unique["key"], train_unique["after"]))

# Predict Class on Validation Set (proper hold-out)
print("Predicting Class on Validation...")
val_pred_class_encoded = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_pred_class = le.inverse_transform(np.argmax(val_pred_class_encoded, axis=1))

# Convert to Python strings
val_pred_class_str = [str(x) for x in val_pred_class]
val_before_str = val_sub["before"].fillna("").astype(str).values

# Predict After on Validation
val_pred_keys = [
    val_pred_class_str[i] + "_" + val_before_str[i]
    for i in range(len(val_pred_class_str))
]
val_pred_after = [
    lookup_dict.get(key, val_sub["before"].iloc[i])
    for i, key in enumerate(val_pred_keys)
]

# Calculate Official Accuracy Metric on Hold-Out Validation Set
val_true_after = val_sub["after"].fillna("").values
accuracy = np.mean(np.array(val_pred_after) == val_true_after)
print(f"Validation Accuracy (Hold-Out): {accuracy}")

# Predict Class on Test Set using the model trained on train_sub only
print("Predicting Class on Test...")
test_pred_class_encoded = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
test_pred_class = le.inverse_transform(np.argmax(test_pred_class_encoded, axis=1))

# Convert to Python strings
test_pred_class_str = [str(x) for x in test_pred_class]
test_before_str = test_df["before"].fillna("").astype(str).values

# Predict After on Test
test_pred_keys = [
    test_pred_class_str[i] + "_" + test_before_str[i]
    for i in range(len(test_pred_class_str))
]
test_pred_after = [
    lookup_dict.get(key, test_df["before"].iloc[i])
    for i, key in enumerate(test_pred_keys)
]

# Create Submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "after": test_pred_after})

# Save Submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
